description: Michael Whatley hit the 100 county milestone on Saturday. When he announced for US Senate, Whatley made a commitment to hit all 100 counties and hit number 99 and 100 this past weekend. Across the state, Whatley has met with North Carolinians who know they can’t afford to add six more years to Roy Cooper’s career as a Career Politician living off the taxpayer dime.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Whatley for Senate
title: Michael Whatley Announces Completion of 100 County Tour – Michael Whatley for Senate
